answer.text: Ask, seek, and knock with persistent faith, for God generously answers prayer

feedback.text: Incorrect. Jesus used the parable to teach bold persistence in prayer: "Ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and it will be opened" (Luke 11:9).
